Dad: Which activity did you choose?
Eva: I wanted to run, but I chose the garden walk.
Dad: Why?
Eva: I felt tired after the morning lessons.
Dad: Was Max with you?
Eva: Yes. We walked slowly and looked at flowers.
Dad: Did you go to the nurse afterwards?
Eva: No. We went to the drawing table.
Dad: When did the afternoon finish?
Eva: At three, not four.
Dad: What should we do now?
Eva: Let’s sit somewhere quiet and look at my picture.
